name: inference-advocate
description: Reference implementation of the client side of AIRP (Accountable Inference Delivery Protocol)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @airp/core && npm run build --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run build --workspace @airp/daemon && npm run build --workspace @airp/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @airp/core && npm run build --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @airp/core && npm run test --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run test --workspace @airp/daemon
scripts.doctor: npm run build --workspace @airp/core && npm run build --workspace @airp/store-sqlite && npm run build --workspace @airp/daemon && node packages/daemon/dist/doctor.js
